mapper.sql: t.id, t.title, t.artist, t.album, t.duration_sec, t.scope, t.owner_id, t.owner_nickname, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.status, t.share_token, t.storage_key, t.source_filename, t.content_type, t.file_size, t.sha256, t.created_at, t.updated_at
FROM music_track t LEFT JOIN music_category c ON c.id = t.category_id
AND (LOWER(t.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%') OR LOWER(t.artist) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%') OR LOWER(t.album) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.scope = 'PUBLIC' AND t.status = 'VISIBLE'
AND t.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT
WHERE t.scope = 'PRIVATE' AND t.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT
JOIN music_access_request r ON r.track_id = t.id WHERE t.scope = 'PRIVATE' AND r.requester_id = #{viewerId} AND r.status = 'APPROVED' AND t.owner_id <> #{viewerId} ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC
